scripts.test:unit: npm run build -w @garanti-kulucka/shared && npm run test:unit:workspaces
scripts.test:contracts: npm run build -w @garanti-kulucka/shared && vitest run tests/contract && npm run provider:coverage && npm run verify:structure
scripts.test:integration: vitest run tests/integration && npm run verify:structure
scripts.test:migrator: vitest run tests/migration && npm run verify:structure
scripts.test:worker: npm run build -w @garanti-kulucka/shared && vitest run tests/worker && npm run verify:structure
scripts.test:ws: vitest run tests/websocket && npm run verify:structure
scripts.test:e2e: vitest run tests/e2e && npm run test:e2e:playwright && npm run verify:structure
scripts.test:e2e:playwright: npm run build -w @garanti-kulucka/shared && playwright test tests/playwright --reporter=list
scripts.docker:build: sh -c 'tmp_docker_config=$(mktemp -d); DOCKER_CONFIG="$tmp_docker_config" docker build -f apps/api/Dockerfile -t garanti-kulucka-api:local . && DOCKER_CONFIG="$tmp_docker_config" docker build -f apps/worker/Dockerfile -t garanti-kulucka-worker:local . && DOCKER_CONFIG="$tmp_docker_config" docker build -f apps/migrator/Dockerfile -t garanti-kulucka-migrator:local . && DOCKER_CONFIG="$tmp_docker_config" docker build -f apps/web/Dockerfile -t garanti-kulucka-web:local .'
scripts.check: npm run verify:structure && npm run compose:config && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:integration && npm run test:migrator && npm run test:worker && npm run test:ws && npm run test:e2e && npm run build && npm run docker:build
